findings.reason: Proof step 2.1 applies the mean-value inequality on B2(x0, 2r) with Lipschitz constant 1/2, but step 1.1 establishes that derivative bound only on the closed radius-r ball. Apply the inequality on the open radius-r ball and extend to its boundary by continuity, or give a segmentwise argument. The Statement need not change.

The Definition invokes the real spectral theorem for H without establishing Hessian symmetry. Add and cite cor-hessian-is-symmetric; V in C4 supplies its hypothesis. The same missing supplier chain affects lem-dimer-central-force-hessian-vector-error Facts F1/proof 1.1; thm-local-index-one-saddle-certificate-from-enclosures Facts F2-F4/proofs 1.1-2.1 and 4.1; thm-dimer-mode-perturbation-and-local-saddle-error Facts F1-F2/proof 1.1; thm-dimer-mode-error-contracts-local-saddle-translation Facts F5-F6/proofs 1.1-3.1; prop-index-one-eigenvector-step-is-the-local-newton-correction Fact F4/proof 1.1; and ex-curved-double-well-has-a-circular-minimum-energy-path proof 2.1. Where the argument identifies D(grad V) with H, also cite thm-total-derivative-computes-directional-and-partial-derivatives so the Jacobian entries match the Hessian convention. These suppliers are available and the stated C4/C-infinity hypotheses suffice.

Facts F3 and proof steps 1.1-1.2 invoke the Taylor supplier, whose stated domain is open and convex, while this item gives a curve only on [0,L]. Make the endpoint C3 convention and the one-dimensional Taylor application explicit. Related uses need the same local-domain clarification: lem-dimer-central-force-hessian-vector-error F2/proof 1.1 can use the line restriction on an open parameter interval around the admissible segment; ex-curved-double-well-has-a-circular-minimum-energy-path F4/proof 2.1 can restrict to a convex ball around the point inside U. lem-centered-chord-and-unequal-step-tangent-error uses an open interval and already meets the premise.

The translation cap K is not tied to an explicit outer-loop counter. Specify the initial counter, residual-before-cap check order, and that an update occurs only while the counter is below K, including K=0.

The update budget N and climbing switch n_climb lack an explicit outer-loop counter and final-iteration check order. Specify the initial counter, tolerance-before-budget order, update only while below N, and that the first climbing force is used at iteration n_climb, including N=0 and n_climb=N.
